question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you choose the sack race or to dunk Justin?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. I know you put on a brave face today. I tried to do the same, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, Howard. Don't worry about it. You're allowed to be sad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just want today to be a day you can remember. A day you can look back on and remember as a time when someone really loved you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Howard. I'm never going to forget you, and I'm never going to forget today...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, after we set off these Widowmakers, today will be `impossible` to forget!
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, after we set off these Widowmakers, today will be [color=#3b78e2][i]impossible[/i][/color] to forget!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. You can't forget a Widowmaker day!
Howard leans down to kiss $ZOE. Suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE?! There you are! Come on! Taylor's calling all the cheerleaders to the parking lot. It's serious.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not sure, but it sounds like I'd better go.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... I guess I'll see you later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course. I love you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you too, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on! Taylor's waiting! Hurry up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, I'm coming!
$ZOE gives Howard one last parting look and leaves...
$ZOE puts her arm around Howard. He smiles softly.
$ZOE holds Howard's hand in hers. He smiles softly.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I said it before, and I'm saying it again...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Good-bye.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And good riddance...
$ZOE turns from Megan and tries not to cry...
When $ZOE returns to the other side of the park, Howard is waiting for her...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I just... It didn't go very well with the rebels.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Awww... Come on, I've got something that might cheer you up!
$ZOE follows him down to the edge of the lake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's so beautiful here. I'm going to miss this.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think you'll have plenty of beautiful sights in France.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I know. It's just... It won't be quite the same. I mean, I'm just trying to savor everything...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Last hamburger, last hot dog, last apple pie...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This isn't like your last meal, is it $ZOE? Because they have all those things in France too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. I don't mean to be a killjoy... I brought you down here because I wanted to show you something I splurged on just for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. Something truly American.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on! Quit stalling! Hurry up and show me!
Howard grabs a box from behind a nearby bush and opens it up. It's filled with a variety of top-notch fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I bought them ahead of time...
$ZOE starts rummaging through the box!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Be careful with them around the water... If they got wet, they'd be ruined!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eeek! You have Widowmakers?! Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You `know` about fireworks?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course! It isn't really Fourth of July without fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Why? Am I weird?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, it's just... When I first met Linda, I had to convince her that the Fourth of July was actually fun `because` of the fireworks!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it's just... When I first met Linda, I had to convince her that the Fourth of July was actually fun [color=#e23b3b][i]because[/i][/color] of the fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you kidding?! I `love` fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I should have known... You're so perfect, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know that sounds sappy. After all, nobody's perfect.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What I mean is that you're perfect `for me`... I just don't know how I'm going to live without you.
nodes.text_bbcode: What I mean is that you're perfect [color=#e23b3b][i]for me[/i][/color]... I just don't know how I'm going to live without you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought we weren't going to dwell on how sad things are...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... That was the plan...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You've got `that` right!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: If Kenji hadn't held me back at the water park, I would have punched a hole in Taylor's face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I heard... She can be really rude sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, she can. And as far as the Auto-Shop is concerned, she represents all of you.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: If she's rude, you're all rude.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's so unfair! I'm not her!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Tough...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I heard what Taylor and some of the other cheerleaders did at the water park...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Then you also heard how close I was to punching a hole through her face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That too... But I wasn't even `there!` I was floating in the Endless River!
nodes.text_bbcode: That too... But I wasn't even [color=#3b78e2][i]there![/i][/color] I was floating in the Endless River!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, that's true. I don't remember seeing her there.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's because she's telling the truth. She's always been nice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: True. You `have` always been nice...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But that doesn't change the fact that you're still one of `them!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But that doesn't change the fact that you're still one of [color=#3b78e2][i]them![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Taylor storms off, continuing her tirade...
$ZOE watches as Megan parks the truck at the nearby skate park. The other rebels hop out. Soon, all of them are tinkering with different parts of the truck.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is it, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel bad. After talking to $Scott, I've said what I wanted to say to just about everybody... Except the rebels. I think I should go over and say good-bye to them now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Are you sure? You're really sweet, $ZOE, but ever since the incident at the water park, I'm not sure any of them distinguish the sweet cheerleaders from, you know...
Taylor overturns a table of paper plates!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who does Megan think she is?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The not-so-sweet ones...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I might not get another opportunity...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... But bring a garbage can lid as a shield against any water assaults.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hardly think that's necessary...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd bring one.
$ZOE walks cautiously over to the rebels, who are still working on the pick-up truck on the far side of the park.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, hi, Ryan.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't say 'hi' to cheerleaders anymore...
Ryan keeps working on the truck. He mutters to himself...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm ignoring cheerleaders... What's wrong with me?
$ZOE sees Kenji bent underneath the hood.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You've got a lot of nerve coming over here... Why don't you go shake a pom-pom at something?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wanted to say good-bye. I'm going to France soon, and I don't know if I'll see you guys again.
Megan wheels herself out from underneath the truck.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Good-bye.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You guys...

options.label: Have every reason to be upset.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, really? What did it look like?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow! Your glare has gotten a lot better!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Unfortunately, you've always had the worst glare on the team. I'd say we should practice more, but you're leaving.
Taylor sighs.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess you don't really `do` 'angry', do you?
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess you don't really [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] 'angry', do you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're just too sweet for glaring. Good try. I guess.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, hey, I guess that `was` a compliment.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, hey, I guess that [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] a compliment.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just don't expect any more, okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Errrg! Of course you forgot!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: On your first day, you were late to cheerleading practice... I should have known then that you'd be a problem!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And when your cousin left, I should have known you'd be quick to leave too!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let me tell you something about America, $ZOE. Here in America, we glare as a team!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, enjoy France. You know what cheerleading is over there? `Miming.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, enjoy France. You know what cheerleading is over there? [color=#3b78e2][i]Miming.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Have fun in your imaginary box!
$ZOE lets Justin's insults roll right off her back. She keeps focused on the target and throws a perfect strike!
A bell goes off, and a split second later, Justin's perch disappears from under him!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `NOOOOOOO!`
He crashes down into the water with a huge splash!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hahaha! All right, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...Now my shirt's all soggy...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Here's your balloon. You earned it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Jane!
$ZOE feels anger welling up inside her! As she winds up, her focus is on Justin's head!
She hurls the ball right at `him` rather than at the target! The ball bounces off the glass right in front of Justin's face!
nodes.text_bbcode: She hurls the ball right at [b]him[/b] rather than at the target! The ball bounces off the glass right in front of Justin's face!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: That was some throw! I'm impressed!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: If only it had been on target...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got distracted...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Me too. Oh, well. Here's your balloon, as promised.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Jane!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shoot! If I had kept the same steady pace, I might've won!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here, $ZOE, you can have the pistol Jacob gave me... My hands are too big for it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, thanks, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Woah! What's that sound? It sounds like a diesel engine...
Just then, Megan and the rebels drive by the park in a huge pick-up truck. In the back of the truck is a large object, hidden by a tarp.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Quick! Glare! Glare the way we practiced!
The cheerleaders glare daggers at Megan as the truck rumbles by...
As soon as the truck passes, Taylor starts yelling at the other cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Was everyone glaring the way we practiced? Maria? Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I was really giving her the evil eye! Just like this!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Me too! My left eye is, like, `really` evil!
nodes.text_bbcode: Me too! My left eye is, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] evil!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What about you, newest girl?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I made the face of Gerdy, the Jilted Whale!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Good... I think...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda?! Hector?! Where are you?!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: They are like octopii in the booth for kissings!
Taylor stomps over to one of the booths...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Errrg! Hector, if you kiss Amanda in there any longer, I will charge you triple!
Hector comes running out of one of the booths, his hair freshly tousled.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can't charge me! I'm a cheerleader too, remember?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever. What about you, $ZOE? Did you glare at Megan like we practiced?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shoot! I totally forgot to glare!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, did you?
$ZOE tries to hop along faster, but she trips and falls!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Oof!`
At the same time, Howard falls down in front of her! Both of them get back up, but $ZOE can't catch up! Howard wins!
$ZOE keeps her same steady pace. Ahead of her, Howard falls down!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Oof!`
$ZOE passes Howard while he's still on the ground! She crosses the line first!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: $ZOE wins! Here's your pistol!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sweet!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess the tortoise does beat the hare after all... Nice job, $ZOE!
Unsure of what to do, $ZOE just stops and stands there! Howard falls down, but $ZOE's too far behind to catch up! Howard wins!
$ZOE and Howard step up to the starting line for the sack race!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Here are your sacks. Don't try to put your arms in them... Apparently, they're for your legs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, thanks for the tip, Zach.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: $ZOE vs. Howard! All right! Just so you guys know, the goal of the race is to go out to that line and come back. Winner gets one of these water pistols...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But that pistol's so tiny! How am I even going to shoot that thing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excuse me? What makes you think I'm going to let you shoot `my` water pistol?
nodes.text_bbcode: Excuse me? What makes you think I'm going to let you shoot [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] water pistol?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, it is so on!
$ZOE and Howard climb into their sacks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All I have to do is go slow and steady... Howard will get overzealous!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: On your mark... Get set... `GO!`
$ZOE hops forward in small, short bursts. Howard takes huge leaps! By the time $ZOE reaches the halfway mark, Howard's on the return leg and headed for the finish line!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Actually, I'm surprised he didn't break up with you! Seeing how simple you are!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm surprised you didn't break up with Howard sooner! Everyone thought you would!
$ZOE and Howard walk over to the growing line for the dunk tank...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Good try, Jane! You throw a lot like you swim... Terribly, that is!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Grrr! I'm out of money! Will somebody hit the target and shut him up?! A free water balloon from me for the first one who does!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a dollar per throw, Howard! I'm not carrying any cash!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I might have one dollar left in my wallet... Here you go... Make me proud...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee, thanks. But I'm not very good at throwing...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's not hard. He only wins because he gets inside everyone's head! Focus!
After a few other students fail to hit the target, it's $ZOE's turn. She pays her dollar and takes the ball.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, if it isn't $ZOE, the escape artist! You hate Howard so much, you had to escape to France in order to put enough distance between you two!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not true!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! Remember, don't listen to him! Don't let him get in your head! Focus on the target!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard's right. I have to focus on the target!
$ZOE concentrates on the target ten yards away... She tries to clear away all distractions...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's okay, $ZOE. I'd leave too, if I was with someone as ugly as Howard!
$ZOE hops up and takes Howard's hand, leading him toward the center of the park...
$ZOE and Howard hold hands as they walk through Centerscore Park, which bustles with activity for $Scott's Freedom Festival!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, look at all this!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I am!
The cheerleaders are setting up game booths...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! What do you think?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They look really good!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maria! Now is `not` chit-chat time! Get those balloons up for the dart throwing game!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maria! Now is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] chit-chat time! Get those balloons up for the dart throwing game!

nodes.text: Maria tries to look busy. $ZOE and Howard continue on toward the field...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, I knew that the cheerleaders were going to set up game booths, but I didn't expect `everyone` to contribute to $Scott's party!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I knew that the cheerleaders were going to set up game booths, but I didn't expect [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] to contribute to $Scott's party!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Neither did I...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look! The jocks brought sacks for the sack race...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Jacob! How are we going to race, man? These sacks don't have any armholes!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: They're not supposed to, dude. You put your legs in them.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh...
$ZOE and Howard pass by the lake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, cool! Sam and the swim team brought a bunch of water toys...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's nothing better than sitting back like this, floating on these innertubes...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Except for maybe floating on these innertubes, watching some of these boys in the water without their shirts...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That is `definitely` a perk of summer.
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] a perk of summer.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, where did Jane run off to...?
And near the water, Justin's sitting on a perch in the dunk tank!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehehe! He's egging on people to try to dunk him!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You can't knock me in, Jane! You couldn't win against me in the election, and you can't win now!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Grr!
Jane hurls the ball at the target but just misses!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey, everyone! A vote for no one is a vote for Jane!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Grr! I hate that guy!
Just then, the nerds ride by on their bicycles!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik and the nerds brought something too... Even if it `is` only their unique perspective...
nodes.text_bbcode: Erik and the nerds brought something too... Even if it [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] only their unique perspective...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You're saying that if Captain Quarch on Space 'Splosions `had` to be replaced by a Founding Father, you would choose `Paul Revere?!` He wasn't even a Founding Father!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're saying that if Captain Quarch on Space 'Splosions [color=#e23b3b][i]had[/i][/color] to be replaced by a Founding Father, you would choose [color=#e23b3b][i]Paul Revere?![/i][/color] He wasn't even a Founding Father!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Paul Revere's midnight ride is the action movie of the American Revolution! Leaders are horse-riders!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What about you, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'd choose Ben Franklin... Besides his intellect, the man had a winning name.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ben Franklin was too fat to ride a horse!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's a traitorous claim! Take it back!
$Scott walks past $ZOE and Howard, holding an armful of hot dog franks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, here's the President himself!
Justin yells from the dunk tank...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: He's not the President anymore! I am! `Come on,` you `voted` for me!
nodes.text_bbcode: He's not the President anymore! I am! [color=#e23b3b][i]Come on,[/i][/color] you [color=#e23b3b][i]voted[/i][/color] for me!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Just ignore him... Glad you guys could make it! I wish I could stay and chat but Angie and I have to cook up... Er... I can't remember how many...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Anj, how many hot dogs are we cooking today?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: `A lot!`

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You heard her, we've gotta go cook up `a lot` of hot dogs!
nodes.text_bbcode: You heard her, we've gotta go cook up [color=#e23b3b][i]a lot[/i][/color] of hot dogs!

nodes.text: $Scott turns to leave, but stops himself, remembering something...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I heard that you're leaving, $ZOE. You know, I'm really gonna miss you. We all are.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, thanks, $Scott. I'm going to miss you too. Where else am I going to find parties like these?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh. Nowheres!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehehe. Save a hot dog for me, will you? I want to savor everything that makes America special!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You got it! And if you guys get thirsty, we've got a cooler of iced teas over by the grill!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, what sounds like fun, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ooh, um, I want to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I've learned anything from cheerleading, it's that you can make something bad look a whole lot better with a smile.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's a very $ZOE way of thinking...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, then!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? I thought we were talking about putting on brave faces...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How about we put on our brave faces now, and we'll handle the fireworks later?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sounds like a plan! Come on, then!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Give us a minute... We need to make a decision...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... But, please, hurry!
Megan gathers up the rebels in a huddle. After a few seconds, they break apart...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Here's what we're going to do! Tell the cheerleaders to retreat toward our truck!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Wilson will pursue...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: When Kenji says `'Get down,'` all you cheerleaders hit the deck!
nodes.text_bbcode: When Kenji says [color=#3b78e2][i]'Get down,'[/i][/color] all you cheerleaders hit the deck!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: We're going to blast Wilson with `this!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're going to blast Wilson with [color=#3b78e2][i]this![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Megan removes the tarp from the bed of the pickup truck. Underneath is the water cannon!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it just me, or is it shinier?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Besides giving it a new coat of wax, we also upgraded the firing rate and power. This thing will literally knock your socks off...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: If we aimed it at your feet!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! You guys are the best!
$ZOE pedals off to tell the cheerleaders the plan!
When she reaches them, Taylor gives her an angry stare!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I've got water on me! You'd better have a plan, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on! This way! Retreat!
The cheerleaders turn, running from Wilson High! The Wilson High students pursue them!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What a bunch of chickens!
$ZOE calls over her shoulder as they approach the rebels' truck!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When Kenji yells 'Get Down!', `get down!`
The cheerleaders crest over a hill. Parked right next to the skateboard ramp is the rebels' truck! The cannon is pointed right at the cheerleaders!
The cheerleaders freeze!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Gasp! It's them!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We hate them!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Do I glare or run?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Keep going! Trust me!
The cheerleaders obey $ZOE, running toward the truck! Wilson comes running over the hill behind them!
$ZOE has been soaked!

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, it is the right thing.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But I don't know if we want to do the right thing considering that Taylor wouldn't bat an eye for us!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please... If not for them, for me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, Taylor can be mean, rude, and downright nasty, but there's one thing you're forgetting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's `our` Taylor! She's on `our` team!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And right now our internal squabbles mean nothing because `our` team is under attack!
nodes.text_bbcode: And right now our internal squabbles mean nothing because [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] team is under attack!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hmmm... I hadn't thought of it like that.
Stiletto falls back, pressing the target!
At the same time, Sam reaches into the dunk tank from behind Skazz and lifts up the box of fireworks! Skazz plunges into the water!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHH!`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are they safe, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Safe and dry!
$ZOE surveys the scene: Stiletto lies on the ground, sopping wet. Skazz looks miserable floating in the dunk tank water. Nearby, Darren crawls toward his pistol...
$ZOE walks over and picks it up before he can reach it. She tosses it to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's all yours, sweetie.
Howard squirts Darren with the rest of the water!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to be honest... That felt good.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: It doesn't matter... You might have won this battle... But you've lost the war! We're an empire!
The cheerleaders emerge from their cover.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That was amazing, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You were like a stuntwoman!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess you were, you know, better than amateur...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, girls. I couldn't have done it without Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No problem, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's just one thing I'm worried about...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, didn't it feel almost... Too easy? I mean, where's the rest of Wilson High?!
Just then, from far away there comes the distant rumbling of car engines and loud music!
Erik peddles toward the cheerleaders on his bicycle!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The Wilson are coming again! The Wilson are coming again!
He crashes into a game booth, falling off of his bike!
In the parking lot, Wilson High students pour out of a dozen cars, each student equipped with state-of-the-art hydro-weaponry!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Reinforcements. We're doomed!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: There are too many of them!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: How come `we` don't get reinforcements?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it! Reinforcements! Cover me!
$ZOE grabs the box of fireworks and gets on Erik's bike. She pedals as hard as she can in the direction of the rebels on the far side of the park.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey, she's got the fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Come on!
The Wilson High students chase after her! The rest of the cheerleaders put themselves between $ZOE and the Wilson army!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Look, she's even got her own little shield of inferior cheerleaders to protect her!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: You're delaying the inevitable!
Water balloons arc across the sky as Wilson and Centerscore clash in the center of the park!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We can't hold them off for long! Hurry, $ZOE!
$ZOE rides up to the rebels' truck!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I told you, crazy as it may be, I don't talk to cheerleaders anymore!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! You don't understand! Look!
$ZOE points to the battle waging in the center of Centerscore park...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Give up, losers!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We never surrender!
The rebels stop their tinkering.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Whoa! So much water!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You guys are in trouble...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We need your help! Please!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And why should we help you guys? If the tables were turned, Taylor wouldn't come to our aid...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: She'd just chuckle and tell the other cheerleaders that we were getting our just desserts.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... Probably true.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: So then, why should we help you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You should help us because...

options.label: It's the right thing to do!

nodes.text: $ZOE hurls the water balloon at Stiletto! It blows apart, soaking her with water!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: `ACCCCCK!`
$ZOE hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Sam? Who's...?
Sam reaches down to grab the box of fireworks, but Skazz sees her!
He grabs her and pulls her into the dunk tank!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `NOOOOOOO!`
Sam plunges into the water! Distracted, $ZOE doesn't see that Darren's crawled to his pistol!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey, cheerleader! Eat this!
The blast hits $ZOE in the face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `ACCCKKKK!`
She lies on the ground, water running in rivulets down her face!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: You can't win! As soon as you throw the balloon, I'll dunk the fireworks!
$ZOE whips out the water balloon Jane gave her!
$ZOE slides! The balloon sails over her head! Her slide ends ten paces in front of the dunk tank, her pistol pointed up at Stiletto! $ZOE squeezes the trigger, but nothing comes out!
Stiletto grins. The bottom of $ZOE's pistol has come unplugged, the water completely drained onto the ground!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Nice move, but you've lost! Your pistol's out of water!
$ZOE jumps!
The balloon collides with her stomach!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `OOOOOF!`
She topples over, the water quickly dampening her torso!
$ZOE doesn't react to the throw!
The balloon tags her across the side of the face! She falls!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `ACCCCK!`
$ZOE lies on the ground, her cheek still stinging from the balloon's impact... The water dripping down her face.
As $ZOE continues her rush, Stiletto pulls out a hidden water balloon and hurls it at $ZOE's head!
$ZOE unloads her pistol on Darren, the water slamming into his shoulder! He falls, dropping his pistol!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: `ACCCCK!`
$ZOE tries to shoot Darren, but accidentally hits Howard instead!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `ACCCCKK!`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `HOWARD! NOOOOO!`
Darren releases his grip on Howard, who falls to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You... You shot me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't mean to, Howard. I wasn't aiming for you!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: But I'm aiming for you!
$ZOE looks up at Darren and stares down the plastic barrel of his water pistol!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `ACCCKKKK!`
The blast of water to her face is cold and unforgiving...
$ZOE is unsure of her aim!
Before she can make a decision, Darren trains his water pistol on her and squeezes the trigger!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `ACCCCCKKK!`
The blast of water to her face is cold and unforgiving...
Stiletto steps out from behind the dunk tank and stands next to the target that activates the dunk tank...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Listen up, Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! We don't have to listen to you! Surrender, Stiletto!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Surrender? Ha! Sorry to disappoint you, but we've got all the bargaining power...
Skazz steps up to the dunk tank, holding a large box.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The fireworks!
He climbs up onto the perch, resting the box of fireworks on his lap.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Heh heh heh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You wouldn't dare! If they get wet, they're ruined!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: We know. Skazz... If you would, please?
Skazz pulls out a small firework and drops it into the water below him.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: `Spaloosh!`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: And how could I forget... Darren, could you come out please?
Darren appears from behind the dunk tank, holding Howard tightly around the neck with a beefy forearm, a water pistol pressed against Howard's temple!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nnnff...

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Keep still!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: That's right. Let's go over your choices, shall we?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: `One.` Go away so we can have an awesome, fireworks-lit Fourth of July. Choose this one and you can have your pathetic boy back!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]One.[/i][/color] Go away so we can have an awesome, fireworks-lit Fourth of July. Choose this one and you can have your pathetic boy back!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Or `two.` Attack us and lose your fireworks... Oh, and of course, `Howard` here gets it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Or [color=#3b78e2][i]two.[/i][/color] Attack us and lose your fireworks... Oh, and of course, [color=#3b78e2][i]Howard[/i][/color] here gets it!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What's it going to be, ladies?
$ZOE sees Sam swimming in the lake. She positions herself just behind the dunk tank, slips out of the water, and crawls along the shore...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I can give Sam enough time, she can come up behind the dunk tank and yank the fireworks right out of Skazz's hands!
$ZOE catches Sam's eye, and Sam nods at her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can do this!
$ZOE pumps her gun and rushes out from behind the booth!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! Where are you going?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Yaaaaaaaaah!`
She reaches Darren first... He twists when he hears her coming, flinging Howard around.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hector, wait!
Hector stops in his tracks! Justin squirms over onto his back! His mouth is taped!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Mmmmfff!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yah!
Hector runs back to the rest of the cheerleaders!
Water balloons arc through the air from behind the dunk tank, crashing down on Justin and narrowly missing Hector!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Mmmmfff!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thanks for the warning, $ZOE! That could have been me out there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No problem.
$ZOE says nothing as Hector runs out. He turns Justin's body over... His mouth is taped shut!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Mmmmmfff!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh no...
Water balloons arc through the air from behind the dunk tank, crashing down on Hector and Justin!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Mmmmfff!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `ACCCCK!`

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `HECTOOOOOR! NOOOO!`
Amanda tries to fight her way toward Hector, but the other cheerleaders hold her back!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Whoa there, feisty red one. It's over! Your slick-haired otter will be in the halls of Valhalla soon, grooming his chest-fur alongside Odin himself!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But he was so young!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE! Come quick! Down by the lake!
$ZOE sees a body floating face-down in the lake!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!
$ZOE runs down to the lake and pulls Sam to the shore! She crouches down next to Sam, who sputters, coughing up water...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think so...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When they came, I didn't know what to do... It was either get blasted by their water guns, or jump in the lake... I... I couldn't give them the satisfaction.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where is everyone? Howard? The rest of the swim team?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Most people ran... The girls swam off... As for Howard, I couldn't say.
Nearby, $Scott sits at the water's edge, holding Angie. Water drips down their faces. They rock slowly...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: $Scott? Angie?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: They soaked the hot dogs, they soaked me, they soaked my girlfriend...
Angie buries her head against $Scott's chest.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: `Sniffle...`

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That I can at least understand... But I can't understand this... It just doesn't make sense!
$Scott gestures out to the water in front of him. Bobbing up and down are dozens of empty bottles of iced tea!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You find them, $ZOE! You find them, and you soak them to the bone!
The sound of a nearby scuffle startles the cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Take cover! Some of them might still be around...
The cheerleaders find cover behind an overturned game booth!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Over there, by the dunk tank!
Justin is lying in front of the dunk tank, face down. Hector gets out of cover and starts running toward Justin!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, let's help him up!
$ZOE starts to rise when movement on the other side of the dunk tank catches her eye!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a trap!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, Jacob.
$ZOE squeezes Jacob's hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're going to be okay!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: For being kind... But you are a terrible liar.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you... Do you know where Howard is? Do you know what Wilson did with the fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I... Wish I could tell you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Your clothes are soaked through! I'm afraid it's going to be a wet ride home...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `NOOOO!`

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it's uncomfortable, and I'm sorry. Can you tell me where Howard is? Do you know what Wilson did with the fireworks?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Just leave me be, $ZOE. Let me dry in peace.
As the girls run off toward the park, Steve calls to them, shaking his wet fist!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You've got no chance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't listen to him!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You'll be outgunned in the end! We're an empire!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What does that mean?!
The cheerleaders return to the park... And find the Freedom Festival completely destroyed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my goodness!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: They trashed our booths!
A low groan escapes from a nearby pile of wet sacks, a lone hand emerging from within. $ZOE pulls the sacks off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jacob! Are you okay?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No... I don't think I'll ever be the same again... One minute Zach and I were running the sack race... Then...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: When that first water balloon hit, he fled into the trees, screaming... I didn't know his voice could go that high!
He grimaces... $ZOE looks down and sees that his shorts, his shirt, every part of him is completely soaked. He looks into $ZOE's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't lie to me, $ZOE. How bad off am I?

options.label: Tell him it's going to be okay.

nodes.text: $ZOE fires, but her shot goes wide!
Steve lifts his pistol toward $ZOE! Suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: `ACCCCCCKKK!`
Steve freezes, then falls face-first onto the pavement, a dark circle on his back... Erik stands there, holding a tiny water gun!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I won it in a sack race against myself!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: So cold...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Erik... If you hadn't been there... I would be... Wet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't think of that. You've got some fireworks to rescue!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's go!
Before Steve can react, $ZOE aims her water gun at his chest and squeezes the trigger!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: `ACCCCCCKKK! NOOOO!`
Steve falls to the pavement, his shirt soaked through!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good shooting! Come on!
Steve lifts his pistol toward $ZOE! Suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: `ACCCCCCKKK!`
Steve freezes, then falls face-first onto the pavement, a dark circle on his back... Erik stands there, holding a tiny water gun!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I won it in a sack race against myself!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: So cold...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Erik... If you hadn't been there... I would be... Wet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't think of that. You've got some fireworks to rescue!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's go!

Steve lifts his pistol toward $ZOE! Suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: `ACCCCCCKKK!`

nodes.text: I won it in a sack race against myself!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: So cold...

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't think of that. You've got some fireworks to rescue!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's go!
$ZOE hesitates!
Steve lifts his pistol toward $ZOE! Suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: `ACCCCCCKKK!`
Steve freezes, then falls face-first onto the pavement, a dark circle on his back... Erik stands there, holding a tiny water gun!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I won it in a sack race against myself!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: So cold...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Erik... If you hadn't been there... I would be... Wet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't think of that. You've got some fireworks to rescue!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's go!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Go get them, girls! For the revolution!
As the cheerleaders start toward the park, a rustling comes from the nearby bushes! A second later, a Wilson High student emerges right next to Erik! He's holding a water pistol!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I've got you now, you bike-riding geek!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Wait! You're Centerscore students!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! Spray him!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's right! And all of you better remember that!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on! Let's get those fireworks back, girls!
Taylor pulls $ZOE aside...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That whole gun-pumping speech thing was impressive, $ZOE. I got chills. It was like I forgot for a second that you were my subordinate!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anytime!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you making a power grab for the top of the pyramid, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I thought you were leaving for France...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Without a clear leader, I don't know who to blindly follow!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Me! You should follow me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not making a power grab! We have to go get the fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... you're saying we should follow you, because you're our leader now?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: $ZOE's the leader! All hail $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... Uh... I meant... Gosh, I don't know what to do... If only I had some direction...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's right. $ZOE doesn't know what she's doing! Follow me!
Taylor pulls $ZOE aside...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't you dare pull that kind of stunt again, $ZOE! I'm watching you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: $ZOE! Can you...... Me? They...... fireworks! Everyone's wet!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?! The reception's bad! What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: We got attacked! ...... Came from nowhere!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You got attacked?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The rebels attacked?! But we weren't even there... Unless... They attacked the innocents!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Those poor nerds!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did the rebels attack you, Howard?! Where are you?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Not much time left. Wasn't...... Rebels. It wasn't them. I'm surrounded, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: They've got the fireworks. I...... you, $ZOE. I love you so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: No! Don't get water on my phone! You'll completely...
The line goes dead...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Snap out of it! How many rebels attacked?! Did they use the cannon?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He said it wasn't them!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't lie, traitor! There's no one else!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoever it was, they took Howard's fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wait... Who's that over there?!
From across the parking lot, a lone nerd rides toward them, peddling furiously!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The Wilson are coming! The Wilson are coming!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wilson High?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We were focused so much on our internal foe that we neglected our greater enemy...
Erik brakes hard when he reaches the cheerleaders... Then, he slumps off his bike, falling to the pavement...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Are you hurt?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They came from nowhere... They spared no one... I can still hear the children screaming!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you saying? What children?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cough cough. I'm not long for this world... They hit me with a water balloon. Look...
Erik pulls up his t-shirt. His stomach has a light sheen of water over it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Gross. Don't do that again.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know. I'm squeamish too. Don't try to give me mouth-to-mouth, popular girls...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Errg! What are you talking about? You're not dying! You're just wet!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wilson's got the fireworks! They're going to use them for their own party!
$ZOE picks up a water gun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not if I can help it! Howard got those fireworks to make Fourth of July special for me.
$ZOE pumps her water gun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm getting them back! Come on, girls!
The cheerleaders start to follow $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excuse me?! Aren't you forgetting your place?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Taylor...

options.label: But I don't care about 'my place'!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Prove it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was one of the targets of the rebels at the beach!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You could still be a spy!
Taylor pumps her water gun!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Any last words?
$ZOE's phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Go ahead and answer... But do it slowly, or I'll blast your face!
$ZOE slowly takes her phone from her pocket... The call is from Howard!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excuse me?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I remember right, you managed to stay completely dry during the rebels' attack...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey... That's true.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How do we know you're not a spy?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay... Everyone calm down... I stayed dry only because that nerd, Brendan, got in the way!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm `not` a spy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And $ZOE's `probably` not a spy, either.
$ZOE's phone rings! She answers it... The call is from Howard!
$ZOE arrives at the parking lot with Jessica. They meet up with the rest of the cheerleaders in a huddle around Taylor's car...
Maria and Amanda start handing out huge water guns, while Taylor climbs onto her car's roof!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Why are there water guns?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll tell you why, $ZOE. Not that it matters to you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: When summer began, we set out to do what every decent American girl sets out to do...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tan, relax, and gossip about boys without the pressures of the modern educational system!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: System!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what if we `'took'` the rebels' sun chairs? They should know that those chairs are ideal for tanning, not for haphazardly draping a towel over while they go goof around like the greasy monkeys they are!
nodes.text_bbcode: So what if we [color=#3b78e2][i]'took'[/i][/color] the rebels' sun chairs? They should know that those chairs are ideal for tanning, not for haphazardly draping a towel over while they go goof around like the greasy monkeys they are!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Monkeys!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Granted, we could have exhibited greater diplomacy...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The point is, none of us deserved the retaliatory drenching we endured at the beach that afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: My hair was damaged!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Jacob and I were in the middle of a deep conversation!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know it, girls. All of us remember who we were with and what we were doing in those fateful moments before Megan and the rebels attacked...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector had just told me I was beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We were going to make out...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yet there was no making out, was there, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, there wasn't. There was only the water... The endless water...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What about you, newest girl? Do you remember?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, I remember! Howard's eyes were salty saucers because his accessory was encased in the sad turtle shell of secrecy!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know why I talk to you!
Taylor turns her attention to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And let's not forget $ZOE... Sweet, lovable $ZOE...
Taylor leaps down from the roof of her car, walks over to $ZOE, and points her water gun right in $ZOE's face!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Treacherous, `Benedict` $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gulp! What?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: First, you're abandoning us for France, and second, when you thought no one was looking, I saw you `walk over` to the rebels...
nodes.text_bbcode: First, you're abandoning us for France, and second, when you thought no one was looking, I saw you [color=#3b78e2][i]walk over[/i][/color] to the rebels...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why? Were you trying to be friends with them? Are you trying to spy for them now?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What I'm wondering, $ZOE, is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you really `with` us?!

nodes.text: Howard takes $ZOE's hands in his.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I said it before, but I have to say it again. I'm really going to miss you, $ZOE. I love you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too, Howard. I'll never forget you.
The last of the fireworks explode, and the ducks fly off...
`Together...`
Congratulations! You played a great game! You really helped $ZOE make a special Fourth of July memory with Howard!

nodes.text: $ZOE leans into Howard and gives him a warm kiss!
The kiss lasts and lasts, until eventually, they part.
$ZOE puts her arms around Howard and holds him tight!
She squeezes as hard as she can!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to let go...
Finally, $ZOE steps back...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: It doesn't matter! I've still got the upper hand!
Stiletto's hand is poised inches from the target, ready to drop the fireworks into the tank! $ZOE sees that Sam is right behind Skazz!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's what I'm counting on!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Woah! What's that sound? It sounds like a diesel engine...
Just then, Megan and the rebels drive by the park in a huge pick-up truck. In the back of the truck is a large object, hidden by a tarp.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Quick! Glare! Glare the way we practiced!
The cheerleaders glare daggers at Megan as the truck rumbles by...
As soon as the truck passes, Taylor starts yelling at the other cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Was everyone glaring the way we practiced? Maria? Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I was really giving her the evil eye! Just like this!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Me too! My left eye is, like, `really` evil!
nodes.text_bbcode: Me too! My left eye is, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] evil!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What about you, newest girl?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I made the face of Gerdy, the Jilted Whale!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Good... I think...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda?! Hector?! Where are you?!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: They are like octopii in the booth for kissings!
Taylor stomps over to one of the booths...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Errrg! Hector, if you kiss Amanda in there any longer, I will charge you triple!
Hector comes running out of one of the booths, his hair freshly tousled.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can't charge me! I'm a cheerleader too, remember?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever. What about you, $ZOE? Did you glare at Megan like we practiced?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shoot! I totally forgot to glare!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, did you?
As $ZOE continues her rush, Stiletto pulls out a hidden water balloon and hurls it at $ZOE's head!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's what I'm counting on!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: You can't win! As soon as you throw the balloon, I'll dunk the fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: It doesn't matter! I've still got the upper hand!
Stiletto's hand is poised inches from the target, ready to drop the fireworks into the tank! $ZOE sees that Sam is right behind Skazz!
$ZOE whips out the water balloon Jane gave her!
$ZOE slides! The balloon sails over her head! Her slide ends ten paces in front of the dunk tank, her pistol pointed up at Stiletto! $ZOE squeezes the trigger, but nothing comes out!
Stiletto grins. The bottom of $ZOE's pistol has come unplugged, the water completely drained onto the ground!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Nice move, but you've lost! Your pistol's out of water!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shoot! If I had kept the same steady pace, I might've won!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here, $ZOE, you can have the pistol Jacob gave me... My hands are too big for it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, thanks, Howard!
$ZOE feels anger welling up inside her! As she winds up, her focus is on Justin's head!
She hurls the ball right at `him` rather than at the target! The ball bounces off the glass right in front of Justin's face!
nodes.text_bbcode: She hurls the ball right at [b]him[/b] rather than at the target! The ball bounces off the glass right in front of Justin's face!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: That was some throw! I'm impressed!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: If only it had been on target...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got distracted...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Me too. Oh, well. Here's your balloon, as promised.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Jane!
$ZOE pumps her gun and rushes out from behind the booth!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! Where are you going?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Yaaaaaaaaah!`
She reaches Darren first... He twists when he hears her coming, flinging Howard around.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: `Get down!`
All the cheerleaders dive onto the ground, except for Amanda, who starts dancing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda, get down!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `am`, Taylor!
Taylor yanks her down!
Megan aims the cannon at the Wilson High students! The motor whirs to life!
It starts firing huge balls of water at them at rapid speed!
`Ka-shunk! Ka-shunk! Ka-shunk!`
A ball of water slams into Steph, sending her flying!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: `OOOOF!`
Another one takes out Elliana!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: `AHHHHH!`
Porscha gets hit!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Now I'm all `wet!`
Then, Alexei gets a water ball to the face!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: `Hrrrrrrk!`
The rest of Wilson High runs away, defeated. Megan turns the water cannon off...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Megan! And Ryan and Kenji too!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: We figured since it's the Fourth of July, we should probably band together.
Taylor walks up to the rebels...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That was... Very nice of you.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Sure.
$ZOE nudges Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And what?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And... Errg... Thank you for doing that. You didn't have to.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You're welcome, cheerleader... Truce?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Truce.
They shake hands...
That night, all of Centerscore, nerds and jocks, rebels and cheerleaders alike, gather for a beautiful display of fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What do you think, Anj?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I like them... `A lot!`

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE...
Howard takes $ZOE by the hand, and they walk down to the shore of the lake...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You saved me today, $ZOE. That was a really cool move you pulled at the dunk tank.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All that agility training in cheer practice finally paid off!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh... I think we achieved our goal of a memorable Fourth of July.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Today was certainly memorable...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Speaking of memories, I remember when I first saw you... I was so nervous! And you were so nice about it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, when I came over to you and Sam, I wanted to know who the pretty new girl was.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really? You looked so cute!
At that moment, two ducks settle on the lake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Look...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I see them...
$ZOE snuggles up against Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kenji should have said something by now!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, cheerleaders! Get a load of this!
Megan lowers the cannon so that it points right at the cheerleaders! The motor whirs to life!
It starts firing huge balls of water at them at rapid speed!
`Ka-shunk! Ka-shunk! Ka-shunk!`
Jessica gets hit and goes flying into the air!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `NOOOOOO!`
Astrid gets picked off next!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Agh! My dignity!
Another ball of water slams into Maria!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `OOOOOF!`
Then Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Wheeeeeee!`
In the chaos, Wilson High flees! Taylor dodges her way over to $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I knew it! I knew you couldn't be trusted!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not a spy, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yeah, you're just so sweet and naive that you actually trusted our fate to our `enemies`, is that it?! I notice they don't seem to be shooting at you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah, you're just so sweet and naive that you actually trusted our fate to our [color=#3b78e2][i]enemies[/i][/color], is that it?! I notice they don't seem to be shooting at you!

nodes.text: At that moment, Megan adjusts the cannon, the ominous barrel now aimed right for Taylor and $ZOE!
`Ka-shunk! Ka-shunk! Ka-shunk!`

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess I was wrong! You `are` that naive...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I was wrong! You [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] that naive...

nodes.text: The ball of water slams into them! $ZOE gets flung through the air, her socks knocked clean off!
The rebels pick up the box of fireworks and drive away!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Thanks for the fireworks, ladies! It's going to be an awesome Fourth of July!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Howard got those for me! It was supposed to be special!
Wow! That ending was soaked through with awfulness! That can't be $ZOE's Fourth of July! Play again and see if you can help her get her special moment with Howard!

Zach runs off into the woods, screaming!
`AHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
I can't let them get the fireworks!
Hide! Behind the dunk tank!
Here's a water balloon for you, nerd!

Jerks!

Grrr... I'll remember this!
Sam reluctantly dunks herself in the water!

Howard, hiding behind the dunk tank, takes out his phone and calls $ZOE!
$ZOE! Can you hear me? They're coming for the fireworks! Everyone's wet!
We got attacked! Wilson High came from nowhere!
Stiletto and Skazz notice Howard...
Well, well, well. Look what we have here!
There's not much time left. It wasn't the rebels. It wasn't them. I'm surrounded, $ZOE.
They've got the fireworks, okay? I love you, $ZOE. I love you so much.
Skazz points his water pistol at Howard!
No! Don't get water on my phone! You'll completely...
Skazz squeezes the trigger, spraying Howard's phone!
...Ruin it...
Well... I knew this moment might come.
Howard pulls out a water balloon. He holds it firmly in his hand. Stiletto and Skazz freeze.
If I'm gonna go, I'm taking you with me!
Howard squeezes the water balloon! Water splashes all over his hand!
What did you think was going to happen?
I was expecting more of a grenade effect. You know, like in the movies.
Well, earth to you, dude. This isn't a movie. It's real life.
How horrible for Howard! Let's go across town to see if we can find some good news for him...
At the hospital...
I've tried Howard's number, but I'm getting a strange message from the phone company.
Something must be wrong with his phone.
He's going to be sad when he finds out what he missed.

Hi!
We're going to teach you `everything!`
Gaaa...

She takes after her mother.
